Welcome to the program

This course will teach you how to find a Mass Desire and turn it into profitable ads. Read this page carefully before you start.

What you need

    • Start small and scale winners
  • Patience: results take 2–3 weeks

How to use this course

  1. Watch every lesson in order.
  2. Complete the research worksheet.
  3. Post your questions in the community.
